title: Genomic DNA Extraction and Sequencing Library Preparation from Phage Stock
author: Shuborno Islam
materials: Removal of Bacterial DNA and RNA
Bring the reagents and buffer to room temperature 30 minutes before the experiment.
Prepare working solutions (reagents and buffer mix) for both standards and eluted phage DNA.
Prepare master mix by adding the following reagents to a 0.2 mL PCR tube on ice rack.
Briefly vortex and spin the reaction mix
Carefully remove the supernatant, without disturbing the beads.
Briefly vortex and spin the reaction mix.
In a thermocycler run the following program with the heated lid on for PCR enrichment.

steps.title: Determine Targeted Phage Dilution
steps.instruction: Identify the phage stock dilution that produces 'webbed' confluent lysed plates (densely packed plaques with only a web of bacteria remaining).

substeps.instruction: Melt soft TSA (0.7% agar) and aliquot 4 mL into screw-cap tubes, equilibrating at 56°C - 60°C.
Prepare phage stock dilutions (10^-2, 10^-4, 10^-6).
Spot 2 µL of each dilution, including undiluted stock (10^0), onto a Salmonella Typhi BRD948 culture plate.
Incubate plates for 16-18 hours at 37°C.
Observe for lysis; if 'Full Lysis' occurs, increase dilution; if 'Single Plaques' occur, decrease dilution.

steps.title: Propagate Phage via Co-Culture
steps.instruction: Prepare a co-culture and use the Double-Layer Agar (DLA) method to propagate the phage.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL of phage from the targeted dilution to 200 µL of Salmonella Typhi BRD948 overnight liquid culture.
Incubate for 20 minutes at room temperature for host-phage attachment.
Add the 250 µL co-culture into a 4 mL soft TSA tube (molten and equilibrated at 56°C - 60°C).
Pour the mixture onto a TSA plate (1.5% agar) and incubate at 37°C for 16-18 hours.
Upon observing 'webbed' confluent lysis, pour 4 mL of chilled LB (4°C) over the plate and incubate at 4°C for 4 hours.
Dislodge the top agar and transfer 2 mL of the mixture into a new microcentrifuge tube.
Add 4 drops of chloroform, vortex for 20 seconds, and let rest for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 10,000 rcf for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer 1 - 1.5 mL of the supernatant to a fresh tube and store at 4°C.

steps.title: Extract Genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Extract phage DNA from the propagated lysate using a spin column method.

substeps.instruction: Prepare enzyme mix: 50 µL DNA Digestion Buffer, 1 µL DNase I (1U/µL), and 0.5 µL RNase A (20mg/mL).
Add enzyme mix to 450 µL propagated phage and incubate at 37°C for 1.5 hours (do not shake or vortex).
Add 20 µL 0.5 M EDTA (final concentration 20 mM) to deactivate enzymes; incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Add 1.25 µL Proteinase K (20 mg/mL) and incubate at 56°C for 1.5 hours (do not shake or vortex) to create 'Phage Lysate'.
Add 200 µL AL buffer to 200 µL of Phage Lysate, vortex, and incubate at 70°C for 10 minutes.
Cool to room temperature, add 200 µL ice-cold ethanol (99%), and vortex.
Transfer to a spin column and centrifuge at 8,000 rcf for 1 minute.
Wash with 500 µL AW1 buffer (centrifuge 8,000 rcf for 1 minute).
Wash with 500 µL AW2 buffer (centrifuge 14,000 rcf for 3 minutes).
Centrifuge for 1 minute at 14,000 rpm to remove carryover.
Transfer column to a microcentrifuge tube, add 30 µL AE buffer, incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature, and centrifuge for 2 minutes at 8,000 rcf.
Re-pass the eluate through the spin column and centrifuge for 2 minutes at 8,000 rcf for higher concentration.

steps.title: Quantify and Normalize DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration using Qubit and normalize samples to a specific amount.

substeps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration using Qubit Fluorometer or Nanodrop; optionally check quality via 0.8% agarose gel (5 µL sample).
Prepare Qubit standards: 95 µL working solution + 5 µL Qubit standard per tube; vortex and spin.
Prepare samples: 99 µL working solution + 1 µL of 100-fold diluted DNA per tube; vortex and spin.
Incubate tubes in the dark for 2 minutes and measure in Qubit Fluorometer (High Sensitivity Range).
If 100-fold dilutions are 'Too Low', repeat with 10-fold or 1-fold dilutions.
Calculate the volume of DNA and nuclease-free water required to achieve 52 ng of DNA in a total volume of 8.58 µL.

steps.title: Perform Adapter Ligation
steps.instruction: Ligate adapters to the normalized DNA fragments.

substeps.instruction: Combine components in a 0.2 mL PCR tube to prepare the adapter ligation master mix (without adapters).
Aliquot 2.97 µL of master mix into the tube containing normalized DNA (8.58 µL) for a total reaction volume of 11.55 µL; vortex and spin.
Add 10.23 µL of Adapter ligation master mix to the fragmentation reaction mixture.
Add 0.825 µL adapter separately to avoid dimers (Total volume: 22.6 µL).
Incubate at 20°C for 15 minutes in a thermocycler with the heated LID OFF.

steps.title: Clean up Adapter-Ligated DNA (0.9X)
steps.instruction: Perform size selection using AMPure XP beads to eliminate small fragments.

substeps.instruction: Allow AMPure XP beads to sit at room temperature for 30 minutes and vortex vigorously.
Prepare 80% EtOH.
Add 20.34 µL of AMPure XP beads (0.9x ratio) to the ligated products; mix by pipetting.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature, then place on a magnetic rack for 5 minutes.
Wash twice: Add 200 µL 80% Ethanol, incubate 30 seconds, and remove. Use a 10 µL tip to remove residual ethanol.
Air dry beads on the rack for 5-10 minutes (do not over-dry; elute while beads are dark brown).
Remove from rack, add 6.95 µL nuclease-free water, mix, and incubate for 2 minutes off the rack.
Place on magnetic rack until clear (~2 minutes) and transfer 4.95 µL of supernatant to a clean tube.

steps.title: USER Digestion and Barcoding
steps.instruction: Cleave adapters and attach unique barcode sequences using USER enzyme.

substeps.instruction: Prepare USER master mix in a 0.2 mL tube: 0.99 µL USER Enzyme (WHITE) and 8.25 µL NEBNext Ultra II Q5 master mix (BLUE) (Total: 9.24 µL).
Aliquot 9.24 µL master mix to the purified adapter-ligated DNA.
Add 3.3 µL of 5 µM pre-mixed forward and reverse index primers separately (Total volume: 17.49 µL).

steps.title: Clean up Barcoded DNA (0.8X)
steps.instruction: Wash barcoded DNA to eliminate products < 100 bp.

substeps.instruction: Allow AMPure XP beads to sit at room temperature for 30 minutes and vortex.
Add 13.99 µL of AMPure XP beads (0.8x ratio) to barcoded products; mix by pipetting.
Incubate 5 minutes at room temperature, then 5 minutes on a magnetic rack.
Wash twice with 200 µL 80% Ethanol (30 seconds per wash); remove residual ethanol with a 10 µL tip.
Air dry beads on the rack for 5-10 minutes.
Remove from rack, add 14.52 µL nuclease-free water, mix, and incubate for 2 minutes off the rack.
Place on magnetic rack until clear (~2 minutes) and transfer 13.2 µL of supernatant to a clean tube.

steps.title: Clean up Barcoded DNA (0.75X)
steps.instruction: Wash barcoded DNA to eliminate products < 200 bp.

substeps.instruction: Allow AMPure XP beads to sit at room temperature for 30 minutes and vortex.
Add 9.9 µL of AMPure XP beads (0.75x ratio) to barcoded products; mix by pipetting.
Incubate 5 minutes at room temperature, then 5 minutes on a magnetic rack.
Wash twice with 200 µL 80% Ethanol (30 seconds per wash); remove residual ethanol with a 10 µL tip.
Air dry beads on the rack for 5-10 minutes.
Remove from rack, add 11.9 µL nuclease-free water, mix, and incubate for 2 minutes off the rack.
Place on magnetic rack until clear (~2 minutes) and transfer 9.9 µL of supernatant to a clean tube.

steps.title: Load on iSeq100
steps.instruction: Pool libraries and load onto the iSeq100 sequencer.

substeps.instruction: Quantify libraries and pool 7-10 ng of libraries into one tube.
Dilute the pooled tube to the desired loading concentration of 110 pM.
Prepare 5% 110 pM working PhiX.
Thaw and prepare the iSeq 100 cartridge following Illumina protocol.
Load 20 µL of diluted library with 5% PhiX into the library-loading well.
Insert the flow cell into the cartridge and load into the sequencer.
